title: ISCROSSFILTERED doesn't see a role's filter

source.quote: any calculation that doesn't filter any Customer will always display the total of all the customers
source.supports: the article's IF ( ISCROSSFILTERED ( Customer ), ... ) takes the unfiltered branch under a role that filters Customer

derivation: The article's measures use IF ( ISCROSSFILTERED ( Customer ), [Internal Revenues], SUM ( SalesNoProducts[LineRevenues] ) ) under roles that filter Customer, and show the non-visual total where the report doesn't filter Customer: so ISCROSSFILTERED ( Customer ) is FALSE there. The query filters nothing.
